name: Yearly review
description: Synthesize the year, extract long-term lessons, and choose next-year direction.

nodes.label: Collect year
nodes.description: Gather monthly reviews, major artifacts, completed projects, and meaningful area changes.

artifact.description: Collected source material for yearly review.

nodes.label: Identify themes
nodes.description: Find repeated patterns, compounding wins, recurring failures, and identity-level shifts.

artifact.description: Themes and lessons from the year.

nodes.label: Archive completed work
nodes.description: Identify projects to archive and resources or memories to preserve for long-term use.

nodes.label: Set direction
nodes.description: Choose next-year priorities, standards, and explicit non-goals.

nodes.label: Finalize review
nodes.description: Finalize the yearly review artifact and create follow-up projects or area standards.

artifact.description: Reference to finalized yearly review and resulting project/task updates.
